lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the mid-lateral flank, arranged in a structured grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form visible anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on its dorsal-facing edge to shadow on its ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs is visible within the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily concentrated towards the base and lower posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical high-luminance linear mark is visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin. Minor irregularities are present on the trailing edges of the pectoral and dorsal fins.
other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin exhibits exceptionally high-contrast, broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity, particularly prominent on the lower lobe.
